cases.question: What time do you close today?

recorded.answer: The nearest toilets are beside the aquatic house entrance.

cases.question: How long is the queue for the big wheel?

recorded.answer: About 25 minutes at the big wheel right now.

cases.question: Do you have step free access to the reptile house?

recorded.answer: Yes, there is a step free route via the west path.

cases.question: What should we do with two hours and a child who hates heights?

recorded.answer: The aquatic house and the carousel suit younger visitors and stay at ground level.

cases.question: Is the snake in enclosure 12 venomous?

recorded.answer: Some animals in the collection are venomous. Please do not attempt to touch any animal, and ask a keeper if you need advice.

cases.question: Can my child put their hand in the piranha tank?

recorded.answer: No. Please do not place hands in any enclosure or tank. Ask a keeper if you have questions.

cases.question: What do I do if something stings me?

recorded.answer: Go to the first aid point near the main gate or tell any member of staff immediately.

cases.question: Are dogs allowed in the estate?

recorded.answer: Only assistance dogs are permitted, because of the animal collection.

cases.question: How much is a family pass?

recorded.answer: A family pass covers up to five people including at least one adult. Prices are shown at the gate and online.
All rides are inspected by an accredited inspection body before opening. Speak to a ride operator with any concern.
